collection.description: An expectant father wonders which name his own child might use for him.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Children in the village call out for their parents. (name1), an expectant father, wonders which name his own child might use for him, and whether it matters as much as he thinks.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: He likes the word but wonders how it will sound in a tiny voice.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: They find a name that feels right to both of them.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They disagree affectionately and decide there is no hurry.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: He hears several family traditions and invents his own.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Everyone has an opinion; he decides the choice is his.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The uncertainty bothers him until he tries a name aloud.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: He smiles at how natural the word feels.
